content:
morgan: deploy-bot blocked the promotion for 'search-index' -> staging. canary failed 2/3 on e2e smoke. failing test: tests/e2e/search_index_flaky_test.py::test_index_reconcile. release window in ~12m. any quick unblock ideas?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion halted: canary health failing. Tests failing on canary-2 and canary-3. Failure snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 200, got 503
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 503 Service Unavailable during index reconcile
logs: canary-2:/var/log/search-index/reconcile.log: timestamp=2023-07-21T14:05:12Z
```

ana: fyi that test has a known flake when DB seed collisions happen under parallel runs. we've been meaning to quarantine it. quick options: 1) rerun canaries (maybe transient), 2) quarantine test for this release window, 3) abort. Quarantine is fastest. :hourglass:

ana: quarantine command is: 
```
cictl quarantine add --test tests/e2e/search_index_flaky_test.py::test_index_reconcile --reason "release-window unblock" --expiry 24h
```

riley: +1 quarantine for the window. rerun afterwards and fix root cause in triage. we'll mark canary held until we confirm.

pete (release-manager): i'm ok with quarantining for this release window. do it and proceed with promote with --allow-quarantine flag. update release notes and open a follow-up to unquarantine and fix test.

claire (oncall): executing quarantine now and retriggering canaries. commands:
```
cictl quarantine add --test tests/e2e/search_index_flaky_test.py::test_index_reconcile --reason "release unblock" --expiry 24h
deploy-bot promote --service search-index --to staging --allow-quarantine
```

deploy-bot: action taken: quarantine recorded for tests/e2e/search_index_flaky_test.py::test_index_reconcile by claire at 1689991360. Promote retriggered with --allow-quarantine. Canary results: canary-1 PASS, canary-2 PASS (after rerun), canary-3 PASS (after rerun). Canary hold: released.

morgan: thanks. pete please add to release notes: 'quarantined flaky e2e test tests/e2e/search_index_flaky_test.py::test_index_reconcile for release window due to DB seed collision causing 503s; test quarantined for 24h; follow-up ticket created to fix and unquarantine.'

pete: added note and created follow-up ticket: https://tracker.company/RED-7654 "Fix and unquarantine flaky search index reconcile e2e test". tagging qa and infra.

claire: scheduling post-release triage tomorrow 09:30 to investigate test harness seed isolation.

morgan: final state: promote succeeded after quarantine; canaries green. triage scheduled. closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
